name: meshy-3d-agent
description: Meshy AI 3D generation and 3D printing skills. Install the whole suite via the meshy-3d-agent plugin, or each skill individually. Version is pinned by .claude-plugin/plugin.json; entries intentionally carry no version field.

plugins.name: meshy-3d-generation
plugins.description: Generate 3D models, textures, and images; rig and animate characters via the Meshy AI API.

plugins.name: meshy-3d-printing
plugins.description: 3D-print Meshy-generated models: slicer detection, white and multicolor printing, Creative Lab products.

plugins.name: meshy-openclaw
plugins.description: Meshy 3D generation and printing in one skill for OpenClaw, with its security manifest and CLI install hint.
